decisions.reason: As a small accessory with lower public prominence than the trailer lines, it is less protected by commitment effects, but its low carrying cost and fit with the after-sales business still make keeping it more likely.
A box car trailer series is close to the firm's core business and was highlighted on the home page, so prior investment and visible commitment strongly favor continuation.

The car transporter trailer is a core transport product and, despite being less prominently shown than home-page products, management is likely to justify the launch and attribute any early weakness to normal market ramp-up.
The low-bed trailer series sits squarely in the firm's main product domain and its home-page placement signals a visible commitment that management will be reluctant to reverse quickly.
The high trailer cover series complements established trailer offerings and its home-page visibility makes withdrawal within a year unlikely unless results are clearly poor.
As another home-page-promoted box car trailer series in the firm's core category, it benefits from strong escalation-of-commitment pressures to remain on the market.
